مِقْيَاسٌ A measure, or thing with which anything is measured; syn. مِقْدَارٌ: (S, Msb, K:) pl. مَقَايِيسُ. (A.) You say, قَاسَهُ بِٱلْمِقْيَاسِ [He measured it with the measuring-instrument]. (A.) And قَصُرَ مِقْيَاسُكَ فِى مِقْيَاسِى Thy measure (مِثَالُكَ) fell short of my measure. (TA.) ―
-b2- A probe with which the depth of a wound is measured. (A, TA.) ―
-b3- مِقْيَاسُ النِّيلِ The Nilometer. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
